title: Widget Sync documentation
back_cover: The documentation of Widget Sync, a tool that copies notes between devices.
seat: Reading it on the project's website in October 2026.
design_context: Install first, configure second; one page only.
intended_takeaways: Install with pip and run init in the synced folder
SYNC_DIR must be set outside the container
done_when: No primary reader ends the walk misled

personas.label: Newcomer with a laptop
personas.brief: Has never run a sync tool; reads every word of the install steps.
personas.goal: Sync one folder between two laptops tonight.
personas.stop_when: Notes appear on the second laptop, or they give up.

personas.label: Evaluator
personas.brief: Five minutes to decide whether this replaces their current tool. Skims from the top.
